no_adcom_quote.quote: Aliskiren has not been discussed at an advisory committee meeting nor is one planned for it.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the original approval of TEKTURNA (aliskiren, NDA 021985). The medical review states aliskiren was not discussed at an advisory committee meeting and none was planned, and the administrative correspondence checklist confirms the application did not go before the Advisory Committee. (References to the Executive Carcinogenicity Advisory Committee (eCAC) concern internal FDA review of carcinogenicity studies, not a public advisory committee, and did not drive changes to the approval.)
